name: Glacier National Park Open 2023
information:
This competition is happening in Kalispell, just next to [Glacier National Park](https://www.nps.gov/glac/index.htm). Early September is the perfect moment to visit GNP: less tourists, great weather. Join us for a competition on Saturday and enjoy your Sunday in the park!

Please be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/), and the [WCA Code of Conduct](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/Code%2520of%2520Conduct.pdf).

The results will be posted in near-real time on [WCA live](https://live.worldcubeassociation.org/).
